eventCancelled.title: This event has been cancelled
eventCancelled.body: The host has cancelled this event, so this ticket can't be used.

pending.title: Waiting for the host
pending.body: The host approves each guest. Your QR code appears here once you're confirmed.

waitlisted.title: You're on the waiting list
waitlisted.body: The event is full right now. If a place opens, this page turns into your ticket.

declined.title: The host couldn't accept this request
declined.body: This ticket can't be used to enter the event.

cancelled.title: This ticket was cancelled
cancelled.body: It can no longer be used to enter the event.

refunded.title: This ticket was refunded
refunded.body: It can no longer be used to enter the event.

checkedIn.title: Checked in
checkedIn.body: This guest is in. Enjoy the event!

alreadyUsed.title: Already checked in
alreadyUsed.body: Don't let this ticket in twice.

notConfirmed.title: Not confirmed yet
notConfirmed.body: The host hasn't approved this ticket.

waitlisted.title: On the waiting list
waitlisted.body: This ticket hasn't got a place yet.

failed.title: Couldn't check in
failed.body: Refresh the page and try again.

ticket.hintValid: Show this code at the door. A printout works too.
ticket.hintPending: Keep this link. It updates if your ticket changes.

staff.label: Door check-in
staff.already: Already checked in at {time}. Don't let this ticket in twice.
staff.intro: You're staff for this event. Check this guest in at the door.

ticket.foot: This ticket belongs to {name}. Anyone with this link can see it, so only share it with people you trust.
ticket.groupNote: Part of a group of {count}. Each person has their own ticket.

email.label: Email my ticket
email.intro: Get your ticket by email We'll send it to {email}, the address you registered with.
email.sent: Your ticket is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder in a minute.
email.failed: We couldn't send the email. Please try again.
email.confirmFirst: Tick the box to confirm your email address first.
email.limit: This ticket has been emailed several times this hour. Please try again later.
email.unavailable: Email delivery isn't available for this ticket right now.
email.lastFailed: Your last email didn't go through.

whatsapp.label: Send ticket to WhatsApp
whatsapp.intro: Get your ticket on WhatsApp Enter your WhatsApp number, then send the message that opens.
whatsapp.invalid: Enter your WhatsApp number with its country code, for example +234 801 234 5678.
whatsapp.unavailable: WhatsApp delivery isn't available right now. Use the ticket link instead.

order.footCompleted: We've also emailed your tickets to your account email. All your tickets are in <link>My tickets</link>.
order.foot: All your tickets are in <link>My tickets</link>.

awaitingPayment.title: Waiting for your payment
awaitingPayment.body: If you've just paid, this page updates by itself in a few seconds. Don't pay twice.

completed.title: Paid
completed.body: Your payment went through and your tickets are below. We've emailed them with your receipt.

expired.title: Your hold ran out
expired.body: We didn't get your payment within 10 minutes, so the tickets went back on sale. If money left your account, it's returned automatically.

failed.title: Payment didn't go through
failed.body: Paystack couldn't take the payment. Nothing was charged.

refunded.title: Refunded
refunded.body: This order was refunded. The tickets no longer work.

partiallyRefunded.title: Partly refunded
partiallyRefunded.body: Some tickets in this order were refunded; the others still work.

disputed.title: Payment disputed
disputed.body: Your bank told us this payment is disputed. Your tickets still work while it's looked into.

waitlisted.title: You're on the waiting list
waitlisted.body: We'll email you if a place frees up. You'll then have 24 hours to pay.

payment.offerBody: Pay before {time} to get your tickets; after that the place goes to the next person.
payment.refundLine: {amount} · {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} ticket} other {{count, number, ::group-off} tickets}}
payment.refundsNote: Refunds go back to the card or account you paid with. Banks usually take 5 to 10 working days.
payment.noAnswer: Still no answer from Paystack. <button>Check again</button>
payment.orderNotFound: This order could not be found.
payment.openFailed: We couldn't open the payment page. Please try again.

myTickets.heading: My tickets
myTickets.emptyUpcoming: No upcoming tickets yet. Find something on Discover.
